movie.title: The Intouchables
movie.overview: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.

facts: Did you know 'The Intouchables' goes by different names in other regions? In the UK, Ireland, and Scandinavia, it's known as 'Untouchable,' while Eastern European audiences might recognize it as '1+1'!

The true story that inspired the film wasn't just found by chance! The directors actually discovered the incredible tale of Philippe Pozzo di Borgo and Abdel Sellou in a documentary called 'À la vie, à la mort' before making the movie.
The real-life aristocrat, Philippe Pozzo di Borgo, became quadriplegic after a paragliding accident, and his carer, Abdel Sellou, was specifically French-Algerian. It's truly a unique pairing!
